verdict.rationale: Xero's own docs say its JAX AI connects to bank feeds and automatically categorizes and matches imported transactions, which covers the core automatic-categorization part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows these suggestions learn from or adapt to user corrections. missing for 10: documented learning from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and accepted or edited, independent or hands-on corroboration of categorization accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts to Xero. Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
JAX, your AI finance partner, reconciles your transactions for you
